SYMPTOM: Returning None from CGEventTap callback supposed to consume the event, but click still passes through to app behind overlay

CAUSE: Bug in the core-graphics Rust crate — None is supposed to consume the event but it actually returns the original event unchanged

FIX:
```rust
// WRONG - crate bug, event still passes through:
return None;

// CORRECT - set event type to Null before returning:
let mut consumed = event.clone();
consumed.set_type(CGEventType::Null);
return Some(consumed);
```

PREVENT: Always use the Null event type pattern when you need to consume events in CGEventTap callbacks in Rust
